info.cls_name: 綠色能源碩一學位學程
info.cls_ename: Master Program of Green Energy Science and Technology
info.scr_teacher: 呂晃志,Tran Thien Khanh,徐兆稹

description.describe_ch: 本課程內容主要從生質廢棄物能源化技術、廢棄物熱處理程序、廢棄物能源處理系統及其系統選擇與設計方法、生質物產能技術、生質物轉化技術及其應用等開始，介紹如何在降低碳排下產製能源，讓一個國家、企業或組織，在一定時間內直接或間接產生的二氧化碳，經過低碳能源、植樹等消除二氧化碳的方式正負抵消，即為達到碳中和，或是淨零排放二氧化碳。目前台灣廢棄物能源技術與應用，已成為廢棄物處置技術之重要替代技術，希望未來能進一步協助國內達到碳中和。
description.describe_eh: The content of this course is form biomass waste to energy, heat treatment to energy, treatment system, system selectionm system design, biomass conversion and application, etc. Carbon emission is used to generate energy, therefore, carbon dioxide can be generated directly or indirectly by a conutry, enterprise or organization within a certain period of time can be offset positively or negatively by means of low-carbon energy, tree planting, etc. to  eliminate carbon dioxide, that is , to achieve carbon neutrality, or net carbon emission is used to generate energy. At present, Taiwan's waste-to -energy technology and application have become an important alternative to wate disposal technology. By the eay, we hope to assist Taiwan to achieve carbon neutrality in the future.

targets.describe_ch: 說明碳中和之發展與沿革。
targets.describe_en: Explain the development and evolution of carbon neutrality.

targets.describe_ch: 理解有關廢棄物能源技術之原理與技術應用
targets.describe_en: Understand the principles and technical applications of waste-to-energy technologies.

targets.describe_ch: 說明生質物轉化處理系統及其技術應用。
targets.describe_en: Explain the biomass conversion processing system and its technical application
